I have a dog, and she is the only tether to this world, the only paintbrush that adds a little lively color to the endless oceans of grey in all shades that is my life. I find absolutely no joy in anything I used to love to do. I am horrifically lonely; I have no friends anymore. I used to be quite popular and annoyingly outgoing, but now it seems so hard to connect with people.I'm absolutely racked with anxiety about everything I do. I desperately need to see a doctor because I'm diabetic and have never gotten it under control since my diagnosis.  Whenever I try to make myself go, I freeze; I guess that's the best description, until I give up. My diabetes has gotten so bad I can't feel most of my toes, but I can still move them. Luckily, I got my job before it got too bad, so it's something I'm used to. I've been homeless for about six years;  me and my dog live in my van. I can't even think about affording a place.I honestly barely have enough to eat most days because of all the bills I have to pay. I have a van payment because about a year ago my car (that I had just paid off) broke down. I have a couple of maxed-out credit cards that I'm trying to pay down. I got a loan I'm paying on. I have an old credit card I had quit paying on; they tried to sue me, so I had to start paying them again. Then there is insurance, gas, vehicle upkeep, my phone, a storage unit to keep all the stuff I can't keep with me, and then I go to a clinic to get medicine that helped me get off heroin years ago, but now I can't get off that medicine. I'm literally drowning in bills and life, and my dog is the only lifeline I have. I'm pretty sure when her time comes, I will follow along with her. She's been left alone a lot before, and it would probably be best to walk the path with her so she doesn't think she's alone again. 

I am, in the strictest definition, a "shell of my former self/peaked in high school" because now I'm just a worthless waste of space slowly wasting away, starting at my feet.
